description.value: The Alley is a bubble tea and specialty coffee franchise cafe on Hornby Street in downtown Vancouver, operating under a 'Hub' concept that blends a drinks counter with individual working pods, a collaborative multi-purpose room for up to ten people, and a lounge area. The menu centres on hand-crafted drinks alongside grab-and-go food including pastries, salads, and fried snacks, with house-made sugar cane syrup and freshly hand-rolled tapioca prepared on-site each day. The multilingual branding (English, French, Traditional Chinese) reflects the cafe's origins as a Taiwanese-rooted international franchise.
